card.name: "In:" in textbook reference citations
card.fires_on: The word "In", the colon after it, or the period after the editors' names, inside a reference-list citation for a book chapter. It follows the chapter title and comes before the editor names.

modes.label: "In" after chapter title
modes.description: The word In that starts the book part of a citation, right after the chapter title and its period.
modes.example: Ettinger DS. Lung cancer and other pulmonary neoplasms.<< In>>: Goldman L, Schafer AI,

modes.label: Colon after "In"
modes.description: The colon that follows In and leads into the editor names.
modes.example: Cryer PE. Hypoglycemia. In<<:>> Shlomo M, Polonsky

modes.label: Period after "eds"
modes.description: The period that closes the editor list and leads into the book title.
modes.example: In: Goldman L, Schafer AI, eds<<.>> Cecil Medicine. 24th ed

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese and mixed-language words with no obvious link.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a reference list where a chapter citation moves on to the book and its editors.
